title: Per-Provider Effects in Open-Weights LLM Routing: OpenRouter Is Null for Closed-Weights but Multi-Provider for Open-Weights
description: Research paper from the Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II series. Tests the assumption that the access route (direct API, OpenRouter, or other aggregator) does not affect measured behavior of frontier LLMs. Establishes a structural split: the routing layer is null for closed-weights models (where the lab is the only upstream) and selectively multi-provider for open-weights models. Documents three structurally distinct categories of provider-layer effect on the open-weights side: a large within-model deployment outlier (Google Vertex's MiniMax M2 deployment, 3.4x baseline composite, replicated 8 days later at within-Google d=0.15 (n.s.) and same-day fresh within-OR contrast d=0.73, p<10^-7), a smaller within-model effect (Kimi K2-thinking AtlasCloud-vs-Google), and a routing-layer integrity pathology (DekaLLM's GLM 4.7 endpoint returning prompt-keyed cached responses).
